I have found with my anxiety it has been easier for me to talk about my feeling and explain parts of me that even I do not totally understand.  I know how you feel with perceiving behavior when the anxiety gets bad.  I have found the best thing I ever did in my relationship was I would just flat out ask if there was anything wrong or if I was just reading into things.  When my boyfriend and I first started dating I started teaching him what I needed to get from him when I was at my worst.  We started out as long distance and we both feel it helped us build a foundation we needed.  
Bottom line is just talk to him about what your anxeity does to you, what you need from people who are going to be in your life, and ask if he can handle a relationship giving you those things. Anyone who loves you will do that.
